name: Distributed Data Volume Rendering via Shear-Warp Factorisation
definition: A distributed rendering technique that divides a large 3D volume into sub-volumes, renders them independently using shear-warp factorisation, and composites the results using the associative 'over' operator to produce an image identical to a single-pass renderer.
summary: Distributed Data Volume Rendering via Shear-Warp Factorisation is a parallel technique that renders large 3D volumes on distributed clusters using a hierarchical tree with specific network and memory optimizations.
